app_fee.value: International applicants pay $75 before the priority date (March 1 for Fall), $135 at the secondary date (April 30) and $175 for late submissions.
app_fee.quote: International Student Priority: March 1 Priority: August 1 $75 Secondary: April 30 Secondary: September 30 $135

also.quote: All applicants to the Wichita State University Graduate School must pay a nonrefundable application fee each time an application is submitted.

fee_waiver.value: The fetched catalog pages give no application-fee waiver for international applicants; the Graduate School's international admissions page that would state the rule is blocked to the fetcher.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School sets no GRE rule for doctoral applicants; each program decides, see the program records.
gre_general.quote: Although an entrance exam is not a requirement for admission to the Graduate School, certain program areas may require an entrance exam.

toefl_min.value: The Graduate School minimum is TOEFL iBT 4.5 on the new 2026 scale; the old-scale 79 on the same line is not recorded as a number.

ielts_min.value: The Graduate School minimum is an IELTS Academic overall band of 6.5.

english_waiver.value: No fetched page names India or an English-medium degree; the Graduate School says no countries in Asia are excluded from the English test, which does not settle the India question.
english_waiver.quote: There are no countries in Africa, South America, and Asia that are excluded from this requirement.
